INSERT INTO release_states (
                   release_id, release_intent_id, project_id, destination_id,
                   artifact_id, status, mode, queued_at, completed_at, updated_at
               ) VALUES (
                   $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'SUCCEEDED', $6,
                   now() - ($7 || ' hours')::interval,
                   now() - ($7 || ' hours')::interval,
                   now() - ($7 || ' hours')::interval
               )
